title: National para-sport activity
description: Before Paris, the French Paralympic and Sports Committee published what clubs and programs were already doing. That kind of report is the community baseline, not a Games-time app.

title: One supporter database
description: Paris 2024 kept a single record for people who joined through social media, the website, or a ticket. Surveys then fed sport-specific email and SMS journeys in five languages.

title: A public channel
description: The International Paralympic Committee used TikTok for match clips, athlete live video, daily highlights, and short explainers of the 22 sports.

title: Access tools at the venue
description: Spectators could use audio description in the official app, a low-vision helmet, tactile tablets, captions, and sign language. These sit on top of the channels above.
